member.summary: Returns true if the user is a member of a roleset that has permission to perform the named elevated action

This method is specifically constructed so as to not throw or rethrow exceptions, as it is used in a functional manner to evaluate all relevant rolesets that a user has to determine if that user is authorized for some elevated action.
It is marked internal so that it can be unit tested independently
